\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{والیبال} (vâlibâl)}{والیبال (vâlibâl)}]{\fa{والیبال} (vâlibâl) — volleyball}

\label{lesson:FA-C514-valibal}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to set a new best, then the Persian for to score a goal.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{والیبال}}
\textbf{\fa{والیبال}} (\emph{vâlibâl}) — \textquotedblleft{}volleyball\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{دانشجوها} \fa{در} \fa{سالن} \fa{والیبال} \fa{بازی} \fa{میکنند}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{dâneshjuhâ dar sâlon vâlibâl bâzi mikonand.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The students play volleyball in the hall.
\end{quote}

\emph{vâlibâl bâzi kardan} — to play volleyball.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{vâlibâl} is a modern loan, usually traced to English \emph{volleyball}. EtymDB has no entry for it.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to set a new best, then the Persian for to score a goal, then say \emph{vâlibâl} again

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{دروازه} \fa{بان} (darvâzebân)}{دروازه بان (darvâzebân)}]{\fa{دروازه} \fa{بان} (darvâzebân) — a goalkeeper}

\label{lesson:FA-C514-darvazeban}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for tennis, then the Persian for a racket.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{دروازه} \fa{بان}}
\textbf{\fa{دروازه} \fa{بان}} (\emph{darvâzebân}) — \textquotedblleft{}a goalkeeper\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{دروازه} \fa{بان} \fa{توپ} \fa{را} \fa{گرفت}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{darvâzebân tup râ gereft.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The goalkeeper caught the ball.
\end{quote}

\emph{darvâze} 'gate, goal' + \emph{-bân} 'keeper'.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{darvâzebân} is built on native Persian parts: \emph{darvâze}, 'gate', usually linked with \emph{dar}, 'door', and the ending \emph{-bân}, 'keeper', as in \emph{bâghbân}. EtymDB has no entry for it.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}
